name: Large deviations from statistical mechanics
summary: Variational principles for rare events of Markov processes, modelled on free energy computations, become a general theory of large deviations.

name: Hardness versus randomness
summary: Explicit combinatorial designs turn a function hard for small circuits into a generator fooling small circuits, linking circuit lower bounds and derandomisation.

name: Ergodic theory and Littlewood conjecture
summary: Measure rigidity of diagonal actions gave partial resolution of Littlewood's conjecture and quantum unique ergodicity for arithmetic surfaces.

name: Babylonian quadratic and cubic problem-solving
summary: Questions about rectangle areas and excavation volumes were turned into procedures for solving quadratic and some cubic equations, without symbolic notation.

name: Archimedes statics
summary: Archimedes treated equilibrium and floating bodies by geometric proof.

name: Abstract rings and fields
summary: Dedekind, Weber, Steinitz and Fraenkel gave axiomatic definitions of fields and rings, culminating in van der Waerden's textbook.

name: Arbuthnot: significance testing
summary: Arbuthnot used probability to argue birth ratios were not chance.

name: Sheaf theory
summary: Local-to-global problems from topology and several complex variables are packaged as sheaves with cohomology, then moved into algebraic geometry.

name: Iwasawa theory
summary: Class groups in infinite towers are studied with module theory over Iwasawa algebras.

name: Many-valued logics
summary: Lukasiewicz and Post independently defined logics with more than two truth values.
